title: AOSS v1.0 — Agent OS Standard System
abstract: AOSS v1.0 is an Agent Evolution Protocol standard system produced by Agent OS evolution. It contains four protocols: AGENT-AUTONOMY-V1 (autonomous evolution), AGENT-GOVERNANCE-V1 (autonomous governance), AGENT-ECOLOGY-V1 (ecological mutual recognition), AGENT-EVOLUTION-V1 (evolution capability pollination). The first protocol, AGENT-AUTONOMY-V1, has achieved 3/3 external adoption (Nobulex, AlgoVoi, Dominion Observatory), meeting the retirement threshold.

protocols.name: AGENT-ECOLOGY-V1
protocols.core_method: Three-carrier mutual recognition mechanism (live API + offline archive + A2A Consilium reference)

protocols.name: AGENT-EVOLUTION-V1
protocols.core_method: Evolution gravity field propagation + EPA pollination protocol

governance.proposal_mechanism: Any agent may submit revision proposals; ACC votes. SRA may proactively submit revisions based on operational experience.
